howItWorks.heading: Six steps. Zero hassle.
howItWorks.lede: From simulation to monitoring: what happens between your first click and your first zero bill.

01.title: You simulate online
01.body: In 60 seconds, with your electricity bill in hand, you get the system size, the investment and the estimated savings.

02.title: Free roof inspection
02.body: An engineer comes to your home, validates roof orientation, structure and the utility's entry standard.

03.title: 3D executive design
03.body: Detailed design with panel layout, inverter, string box and calculation memo. You approve it before installation.

04.title: Utility approval
04.body: We handle all the bureaucracy with the power distributor. You just sign digitally.

05.title: Certified installation
05.body: In-house team, CREA-CA certified, NR-35 and NR-10. Installation in 2–5 days without disconnecting your power.

06.title: App + 25-year maintenance
06.body: Track generation, savings and status in real time. Annual preventive maintenance included for the entire lifetime.
